# Junior Data Analyst

**Havnelys Logistics ApS** · Copenhagen (in the office, or hybrid after your first three months) · 3 positions

Havnelys moves pallets for 400 shops around the Øresund region. Our planners need clear
numbers every morning, and we are hiring three junior analysts to give them that.

## What you will do

- Build and maintain reports on deliveries, delays and warehouse capacity.
- Answer questions from planners and drivers' team leads with data.
- Help clean up how we define our key numbers.

## What we are looking for

- Good SQL: you can join, group and filter without looking it up.
- Confident with Excel.
- Some experience with Power BI or a similar reporting tool.
- You explain numbers simply to people who don't work with data.
- You must be able to work in the EU.

No years of experience required: recent graduates are welcome.

## Nice to have

- A little Python.
- Danish, as many of our planners prefer it.

We offer training, a mentor and a monthly team breakfast.
